metrics.label: Reporting active installations
metrics.formula: Count distinct id with m>0 or game starts>0 or stories opened>0 within period
metrics.limitation: Do not label unique children or total audience.

metrics.label: New observed installations
metrics.formula: Count distinct id whose earliest retained observed play date is in period
metrics.limitation: Cleared storage and late first reports change this.

metrics.label: Currently reporting online
metrics.formula: Count devices with active session presence newer than LIVE_MS (5 minutes)
metrics.limitation: Presence is approximate; stale means unconfirmed/offline.

metrics.label: Play time
metrics.formula: Sum accepted days[].m for eligible ordinary traffic; exclude bot store
metrics.limitation: Menu/paused time follows existing producer hooks; not total screen time.

metrics.label: Completion participation ratio
metrics.formula: Sum g[id][1] / sum g[id][0] over matching profile/device/day buckets
metrics.limitation: Not attempt conversion: split-screen creates two participations and late terminal events can cross windows.

metrics.label: Early-exit participation ratio
metrics.formula: Sum g[id][2] / sum g[id][0] over matching buckets
metrics.limitation: Do not infer difficulty or dissatisfaction as a confirmed cause.

metrics.label: Story opens
metrics.formula: Sum days[].t
metrics.limitation: No existing completion count should be invented.

metrics.label: Sampled FPS
metrics.formula: sum f[0] / sum f[1] when f[1]>0
metrics.limitation: Weighted by samples; do not average device averages.

metrics.label: Low-FPS samples
metrics.formula: sum f[2] / sum f[1] when f[1]>0
metrics.limitation: Current threshold below 20 FPS.

metrics.label: Startup median
metrics.formula: Median retained st[][2], split by st[][3] and originating build
metrics.limitation: Capped samples, not population p95.

metrics.label: Measured active drawing FPS
metrics.formula: sum b[1] / sum b[9] when seconds>0
metrics.limitation: Exclude idle and unmeasured intervals.

metrics.label: Battery loss per measured hour
metrics.formula: (sum b[7]/10) / (sum b[6]/60) when battery minutes>0
metrics.limitation: Unavailable on many browsers; never watts or device energy cost.

metrics.label: Website page views
metrics.formula: Sum pageViews counters for selected allowlisted routes
metrics.limitation: Not unique visitors, visits or people.

metrics.label: Website Play clicks
metrics.formula: Sum playConversions
metrics.limitation: Existing counter name does not mean a successful game start.

metrics.label: Website reading time
metrics.formula: Sum activeTimeTotalSec
metrics.limitation: Best-effort; no per-visitor retention or complete session funnel.

metrics.label: Affected reporting devices
metrics.formula: Distinct report id per problem/build within retained evidence
metrics.limitation: Unreported devices are unknown; reporting count differs from total incidence.

metrics.label: Open confirmed regressions
metrics.formula: Count triaged problems with confirmed regression classification and nonterminal status
metrics.limitation: Existing auto reports do not prove regression.

metrics.label: Observed D7 return
metrics.formula: Eligible cohort installations observed active on cohortDay+7 / installations first active on cohortDay; exact-day definition
metrics.limitation: Only matured cohorts; late data window 7 days; label provisional; no cross-device person identity.

metrics.label: Attempt completion
metrics.formula: Distinct completed attemptIds / eligible started attemptIds from same start cohort
metrics.limitation: Include pending outcomes separately; abandoned/expired definitions in contracts.

metrics.label: Boot readiness
metrics.formula: Distinct boot IDs with ready / distinct reportable boot starts in start cohort
metrics.limitation: Never captures failures before instrumentation can run/send.

metrics.label: First playable time p95
metrics.formula: Nearest-rank p95 of matched readyAt-startedAt within comparable build/device cohort
metrics.limitation: Show n; target at least 20 samples before directional status.

metrics.label: Connection success
metrics.formula: Successful connection attemptIds / eligible connection attemptIds
metrics.limitation: Separate direct/relay and failures/timeouts; exclude synthetic runs.

metrics.label: Recorded voice success
metrics.formula: Successful recorded playback events / attempted recorded playback events
metrics.limitation: Requires source/outcome instrumentation; missing-line inbox is not a denominator.

metrics.label: Applied configuration coverage
metrics.formula: Eligible cohort devices acknowledging revision or later compatible effective hash / fixed eligible cohort size
metrics.limitation: Denominator from last-30-day reporting cohort snapshot; missing offline devices stay unconfirmed.

metrics.label: Confirmed report recovery time
metrics.formula: Median verifiedAt-firstReportedAt for comparable resolved cases
metrics.limitation: Separate fixed-in-code, deployed and verified.

metrics.label: Content recording coverage
metrics.formula: Required static language/voice keys with playable verified recordings / required keys
metrics.limitation: Bounded static catalogue; dynamic lines and family recordings separately scoped.

metrics.label: Website review coverage
metrics.formula: Changed catalogue items with current source-linked review / items requiring review
metrics.limitation: Review lock is evidence of reviewed work, not automatic prose correctness.

metrics.label: Actual operating cost
metrics.formula: Sum recognised actual expense lines in period after explicit currency conversion
metrics.limitation: Exclude estimates; show import completeness and tax basis.

metrics.label: Budget remaining
metrics.formula: Approved period budget - recognised actual costs - separately reserved commitments
metrics.limitation: Display actual-only and commitment-adjusted balances separately.

metrics.label: Monthly forecast
metrics.formula: Fixed monthly commitments + variable actual-to-date + remainingDays * trailing-7-complete-day variable mean
metrics.limitation: Avoid double-counting commitments; insufficient coverage -> unavailable.

metrics.label: Cost per reporting active installation
metrics.formula: Comparable recognised actual operating cost / M01
metrics.limitation: Reporting subset denominator; not acquisition cost or unique customer cost.

metrics.label: Cost per reported play hour
metrics.formula: Comparable actual operating cost / (M04/60)
metrics.limitation: Reporting opt-outs bias denominator.

metrics.label: Contribution margin
metrics.formula: Recognised revenue - refunds - payment fees - attributed variable cost
metrics.limitation: Only after approved revenue model and accounting definitions.

metrics.label: Quota headroom
metrics.formula: Provider limit - current billed/observed usage in matching billing window
metrics.limitation: Unknown limit or stale feed means unavailable.

metrics.label: Job success
metrics.formula: Successful terminal workflow runs / terminal eligible runs
metrics.limitation: Queued/running/cancelled/retried visible separately.

metrics.label: Delivery delay
metrics.formula: Applied receipt timestamp - availableAt for eligible compatible devices
metrics.limitation: Device clock can be wrong; validate and show receipt-time alternative.

metrics.label: Days-to-quota estimate
metrics.formula: Remaining quota / trailing-7-day matching usage mean
metrics.limitation: Only when same units/window and positive measured rate.

metrics.label: Affected-device error proportion
metrics.formula: Distinct active reporting installations with error>0 / distinct active reporting installations
metrics.limitation: Not crash-free sessions; no existing complete session outcomes.
